name: The Hackberry of Cortesano
verified_sources: MASAF national monumental trees register, sheet 11/L378/TN/22
access: Free, on a public street (Salita ai Spiazzi) near the church of Sant'Antonio in the Cortesano hamlet
transport: Trentino Trasporti bus line 3 from central Trento to Cortesano, about 24 minutes, then a short walk
verify_notes: Girth 410cm, height 10m, altitude 570m per the MASAF register (sheet 11/L378/TN/22, locality 'Cortesano - Salita ai Spiazzi'). One of Trento's 18 officially designated monumental trees (declared 2024, per municipal/MUSE survey covered by ANSA, il Dolomiti, Il T Quotidiano etc. 2026-03-11). Il T Quotidiano's article places it specifically 'a Cortesano vicino alla chiesa di Sant'Antonio' (at Cortesano, near the church of Sant'Antonio), which independently corroborates the register's street-level locality and confirms it stands on public ground rather than private grounds, unlike several other candidates checked this pass. No source gives a planting date or age estimate; leave age empty rather than invent one. Cortesano is a hillside hamlet about 6.7km/6.2km road-distance from central Trento (per rome2rio and italiamappata.it), reachable by city bus line 3 in about 24 minutes, so it clears the roughly-30-minute day-trip boundary. This is a standalone hillside tree, not part of the existing 3.8km city-centre walk (same pattern as the already-published Chestnut of Sardagna, tre_007). Flagged because only one press source names the precise site (no independent photo or second physical description found this pass) and no age is documented.
